contents_summary: Single-table Word document (35 units) of laboratory findings at presentation on hospital day 1 with values, units and reference intervals for 30 results (complete blood count with differential, chemistry, cardiac and inflammatory markers, coagulation tests) and an abbreviation footnote. No images.

blocks.contents: One laboratory table titled as laboratory findings at presentation on hospital day 1: column headers Value, Unit, Reference value; complete blood count (white blood cell with differential percentages, hemoglobin, platelet), chemistry and coagulation rows (liver and renal tests, electrolytes, creatine kinase, CRP, procalcitonin, CK-MB, high sensitivity troponin T, aPTT, INR, fibrinogen, FDP, D-dimer) and an abbreviation footnote.
blocks.clinical_relevance_notes: The table names no patient; the case text says other laboratory results at presentation are summarized in Supplementary Table 1, so ownership comes from that article sentence.
limitations: No printed rights notice in the document; article source license retained without blanket relicensing.
Table names no patient; ownership rests on the article sentence pointing to Supplementary Table 1.
Units are kept as printed, including capitalised "Mg/dL" and "Ng/mL" and "/mL" counts; none are corrected.
Creatinine and INR reference cells are blank in the table; reference_range_text is null for them.
The troponin reference interval in the table differs from the one printed in the case text; both are kept in their own sources.
